package.description: QEMU disk image utility for Windows

en-US.description: QEMU disk image utility for Windows
en-US.longDescription: It is used for converting, creating, and consistency checking of various virtual disk formats. It is compatible with Hyper-V, KVM, VMware, VirtualBox, and Xen virtualization solutions. This build has been optimized for Windows Server (x64).
en-US.name: qemu-img
